context: The starting order is [4, 2, A, 5, 3], with the ace worth 1. First put the leftmost 4 in the sorted section. Then take cards from the right end of the unsorted section, in the order 3, 5, A, 2.
description: The six animation steps match the six stages in the state table above. See that table for the full card order at each stage. The steps below describe how the sections change during playback. Cards overlap in a fan in both sections, in the same left-to-right order as in the table.

steps.announcement: The five initially unsorted cards are [4, 2, A, 5, 3].
steps.explanation: Initially, all five cards are in the light red unsorted panel. There is no sorted panel yet.
steps.key_state: Initial state: 0 sorted cards and 5 unsorted cards, [4, 2, A, 5, 3].
steps.title: Five unsorted cards

steps.announcement: Put the 4 in the sorted section. The unsorted section now contains [2, A, 5, 3].
steps.explanation: The 4 moves to a new light green sorted panel on the left. The other four cards remain on the right.
steps.key_state: One sorted card, [4]. Four unsorted cards, [2, A, 5, 3].
steps.title: Put the 4 in the sorted section

steps.announcement: Take the 3 and insert it before the 4. The sorted section is now [3, 4].
steps.explanation: Insert the rightmost 3 before the 4. The sorted section now has two cards, and the unsorted section has three.
steps.key_state: After inserting the 3, there are two sorted cards, [3, 4], and three unsorted cards, [2, A, 5].
steps.title: Insert the 3 before the 4

steps.announcement: Take the 5 and insert it after the 4. The sorted section expands to [3, 4, 5].
steps.explanation: Insert the rightmost 5 at the end of the sorted section. The two sections now contain three and two cards, respectively.
steps.key_state: After inserting the 5, there are three sorted cards, [3, 4, 5], and two unsorted cards, [2, A].
steps.title: Insert the 5 at the end of the sorted section

steps.announcement: Take the ace and insert it before the first card, the 3. The sorted section expands to [A, 3, 4, 5].
steps.explanation: Insert the rightmost ace at the start of the sorted section. The two sections now contain four cards and one card, respectively.
steps.key_state: After inserting the ace, there are four sorted cards, [A, 3, 4, 5], and just one unsorted card, [2].
steps.title: Insert the ace before the 3

steps.announcement: Insert the final 2 between the ace and the 3. All five cards are now sorted: [A, 2, 3, 4, 5].
steps.explanation: Insert the last card, the 2, between the ace and the 3. All five cards are now sorted. The light red unsorted panel disappears, leaving only the light green sorted panel.
steps.key_state: All five cards are sorted. The sorted section is [A, 2, 3, 4, 5], and there are no unsorted cards.
steps.title: Insert the 2 between the ace and the 3

description: Five arrows connect six hands in a clockwise U: left to right across the top, down the right side, then right to left along the bottom. Within each hand, the light green area on the left is sorted and the light red area on the right is unsorted. Initially only the unsorted area appears. In the last hand only the sorted area appears.

frames.explanation: A single card is already sorted. After each insertion, the left section stays in ascending order and the right section has one fewer card. Once the unsorted section is empty, the entire hand is sorted. The figure shows the result of each insertion without depicting individual comparisons or temporary moves.
frames.title: Sorting playing cards with insertion sort

tables.caption: Actions and section contents for the six hands
rows: Put the leftmost 4 in the sorted section
Take the 3. Since 3 is less than 4, insert it before the 4.
Take the 5. Since 5 is greater than 4, insert it at the end.
Take the ace. Since the ace is less than 3, insert it at the beginning.
Take the 2. It is greater than the ace and less than 3, so insert it between them.
